summary: Iteration 12 - Image URL handling, Profile features, Address autocomplete testing complete. All 20 backend tests passed (1 skipped - supplier login). All frontend E2E tests passed. Key features verified: getImageUrl() helper properly handles /api/uploads/, /uploads/, and full URLs. Profile page correctly hides IČO/DIČ/Company fields for nepodnikatel customers. Address autocomplete works with 400ms debounce. Demand edit modal has all fields. Chat button hidden for customers on open demands. Email verification flow working correctly.

minor.issue: Returns 500 when demand has empty string budget_min/budget_max (Pydantic validation error)
minor.note: This was fixed in iteration 11 for regular demand endpoints but admin endpoint may still have issue

issues: Uses browser's default date picker instead of custom shadcn calendar component - minor UX inconsistency (carried over from previous iterations)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All image URL handling features tested and working. Key behaviors: 1) getImageUrl() in ProfilePage.jsx and imageUrl.js handles /api/uploads/x.jpg, /uploads/x.jpg, and full https:// URLs correctly. 2) Profile page for nepodnikatel customers hides IČO, DIČ, Název firmy, Sídlo, Pobočka fields and shows Trvalý pobyt, Skutečná adresa, Datum narození. 3) Address autocomplete uses 400ms debounce and works correctly. 4) Demand edit modal has all fields: title, description, address, budget_min, budget_max, deadline, photos. 5) Chat button hidden for customers on open demands. 6) Photo upload in profile uses dropdown menu with Vyfotit/Vybrat z galerie options. 7) Registration photo upload uses direct file input (label). 8) Email verification flow: registration shows verification screen, unverified login shows orange message with resend link. 9) Admin login bypasses verification.
